data.name: Suhailah
data.long_meaning: Suhailah is an Arabic name for a girl, which means 'a star in the Southern Hemisphere'. In Islamic tradition, Suhailah is known as the brightest star that guided the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and his companions during their migration from Mecca to Medina.

data.cultural_impact: The name Suhailah has been in use for centuries in the Arab world, and its association with stars has deep cultural significance. In Islamic astronomical literature, Suhailah is mentioned as one of the three bright stars in the constellation of Scorpio, forming a triplet known as the Belt of Scorpio. This star holds a special place in Arab culture, as it is believed to have guided the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) during a crucial period of his life. The name Suhailah is a celebration of this rich Arabic cultural heritage.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, the story of Suhailah is a powerful reminder of faith and guidance from Allah. The Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and his companions faced numerous challenges during their migration to Medina. The night sky, filled with stars, provided them comfort and direction. Among the stars, the bright star of Suhailah shone the most and guided the Prophet and his companions on their safe journey to the city. The spiritual significance of Suhailah is derived from its role as a guiding light in times of uncertainty, representing the unwavering belief in Allah's guidance and the hope for a brighter future.
